name: Wiki Crawler
description: BFS HTML crawlers for Lexicanum (Warhammer 40k), TVTropes Warhammer40000, and Warhammer Fantasy Fandom. search.query expands from a seed slug; search.fetch returns the page's markdown body.

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header. Falls back to a deepresearch-platform default.

max_pages_per_query.description: Hard cap on pages visited per search.query call. Default 25.
